candidates.source_name: Český statistický úřad (ČSÚ) — Czech Statistical Office, main portal
candidates.why_relevant: National statistical authority and the root pointer for all CZ official statistics outside the central bank: retail turnover, household expenditure, ICT/e-payment behaviour, business ICT and e-commerce. Domain migrated from czso.cz to csu.gov.cz, so both hostnames must be tracked.
candidates.legal_status: official public statistics; open licence for most products (CC-BY style attribution requested)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl product catalogue + 'Rychlé informace' release pages; prefer the open-data/DataStat API over HTML scraping
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (cs) + snowballing from ICT household statistics
queries_used: ČSÚ maloobchod tržby statistika časové řady VDB veřejná databáze API

candidates.source_name: ČSÚ — Otevřená data (open data landing page / LKOD)
candidates.why_relevant: Entry point to ČSÚ's Local Open Data Catalogue (LKOD), listing machine-readable statistical datasets, code lists and classifications that feed the National Open Data Catalogue. This is the main pointer to further machine-readable series relevant to retail, ICT and household payment behaviour.
candidates.legal_status: open data under CZ open-data legislation (zákon č. 106/1999 Sb. + 261/2021)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest DCAT-AP catalogue records, then bulk-download CSV/JSON-STAT distributions on a scheduled job
queries_used: csu.gov.cz otevřená data katalog produktů API JSON datové sady statistika

candidates.source_name: ČSÚ DataStat — statistical data application and public API
candidates.why_relevant: DataStat exposes ČSÚ time series (including short-term trade / retail turnover statistics) through a documented REST API returning JSON-STAT. This is the highest-value machine-readable route to CZ retail and consumption series that contextualise card/cash spend.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: REST API pull in JSON-STAT (pattern observed: https://data.csu.gov.cz/api/dotaz/v1/data/vybery/{selectionCode}); cache selection codes from the API overview PDF
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballing from ČSÚ open data page
queries_used: csu.gov.cz otevřená data katalog produktů API JSON datové sady statistika
ČSÚ maloobchod tržby statistika časové řady VDB veřejná databáze API

candidates.source_name: ČSÚ Veřejná databáze (VDB) — public statistical database
candidates.why_relevant: The long-standing multidimensional query database for all published CZ statistics — retail turnover, household expenditure, ICT indicators. Useful for back-series that DataStat may not expose. JSF-based UI makes scraping brittle; prefer its export endpoints.
candidates.legal_status: official statistics, reuse permitted with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use VDB export (CSV/XLSX) links per table code rather than session-bound JSF scraping
queries_used: ČSÚ maloobchod tržby statistika časové řady VDB veřejná databáze API

candidates.source_name: ČSÚ — ICT v domácnostech a uživatelé ICT (household ICT survey, incl. internet banking & online payments)
candidates.why_relevant: The Eurostat-harmonised annual household ICT survey is the authoritative non-central-bank source on internet banking penetration, online purchasing and online payment behaviour by age/region — the demand-side complement to ČNB payment statistics. Example finding: internet banking used by 77% of persons 16+ in 2024.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual scheduled fetch of the topic page, its XLSX table annexes and the accompanying PDF publication
queries_used: ČSÚ statistika využívání informačních technologií domácnosti internetové bankovnictví platby

candidates.source_name: ČSÚ — Podniky a ICT / Využívání ICT v podnikatelském sektoru (business ICT & e-commerce survey, ICT 5-01)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual ICT 5-01 survey of enterprises covers e-commerce sales, web sales channels and the financial significance of e-commerce transactions — the merchant/acceptance side that frames POS and e-commerce acquiring demand in CZ.
candidates.legal_status: official statistics; microdata restricted, aggregates open
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch of publication PDF + XLSX annexes; cross-link to Eurostat isoc_e datasets for comparability
queries_used: ČSÚ "informační technologie v podnicích" elektronický obchod platby kartou statistika

candidates.source_name: ČSÚ — Information Society in Figures (English annual publication)
candidates.why_relevant: English-language annual compendium of CZ vs EU digital indicators including internet banking, online shopping and web sales — the fastest route to comparable figures without Czech-language parsing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download + table extraction
queries_used: Czech Statistical Office English "Information Society in Figures" e-commerce online payments publication

candidates.source_name: ČSÚ — Statistika rodinných účtů (SRÚ, household budget survey linked to SILC)
candidates.why_relevant: The household-diary survey (~3,000 households, continuous since 2017, linked to Životní podmínky/EU-SILC) records daily monetary expenditure by category — the only official CZ micro-level basis for consumer spending structure that underpins cash-versus-card usage analysis.
candidates.access_status: aggregates public; anonymised microdata on request/paid
candidates.legal_status: official statistics; microdata subject to statistical confidentiality (zákon o státní statistické službě)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch of published aggregate tables; separate formal request for anonymised microdata if needed
queries_used: ČSÚ statistika rodinných účtů vydání domácností SILC platby hotovost

candidates.source_name: ČSÚ — Krátkodobé statistiky obchodu / Maloobchod (short-term retail turnover, Rychlé informace)
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly retail turnover releases are the standard denominator for card-spend and POS-volume analysis (turnover growth, e-shop segment split). Published on a fixed calendar as 'Rychlé informace' with machine-readable annexes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scheduled fetch keyed to the ČSÚ release calendar; prefer DataStat series over the HTML release
queries_used: ČSÚ maloobchod tržby statistika časové řady VDB veřejná databáze API

candidates.source_name: Statistika&My — ČSÚ analytical magazine
candidates.why_relevant: ČSÚ's own commentary channel: interprets ICT/digital-society and consumption releases, flags upcoming survey rounds, and often surfaces indicators before they are easy to find in the databases. Good early-warning and pointer layer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/feed or tag-page polling on digital-society and consumption tags
queries_used: ČSÚ statistika využívání informačních technologií domácnosti internetové bankovnictví platby

candidates.source_name: Národní katalog otevřených dat (NKOD) / data.gov.cz — Portál o datech ČR
candidates.why_relevant: The federated national catalogue aggregating all CZ public-sector open datasets (DCAT-AP v1.2), including ministry and regulator publishers. Single best pointer for discovering machine-readable series relevant to payments, retail and financial supervision that are not advertised on the publishers' own sites.
candidates.access_status: public; SPARQL, Triple Pattern Fragments and GraphQL endpoints
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic SPARQL queries against https://data.gov.cz/sparql filtering DCAT keywords/themes (platební styk, banky, finance, maloobchod); persist dataset+distribution URLs for downstream harvesting
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (cs) + snowballing to integration docs on GitHub
queries_used: data.gov.cz otevřená data Ministerstvo financí finanční trh
Národní katalog otevřených dat data.gov.cz SPARQL endpoint API dokumentace

candidates.source_name: NKOD integration documentation & reference LKOD implementation (datagov-cz on GitHub)
candidates.why_relevant: Documents the exact machine interfaces (SPARQL, TPF, GraphQL) and DCAT-AP profile used by NKOD, plus the reference local-catalogue implementation. Essential to build a durable harvester rather than scraping the portal UI.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read + watch repo for interface changes
queries_used: Národní katalog otevřených dat data.gov.cz SPARQL endpoint API dokumentace

candidates.source_name: Portál otevřených dat Ministerstva financí (data.mf.gov.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: MF ČR's own open-data portal with 1,100+ datasets covering the ministry and its subordinate bodies (tax and customs administration, public budgets, control activity), and its own SPARQL catalogue endpoint. Includes an EET (electronic sales records) topic area directly relevant to POS/cash-register policy.
candidates.access_status: public, free; CSV downloads + SPARQL catalogue API
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the catalogue SPARQL endpoint (https://data.mf.gov.cz/api/katalog.html) for dataset URIs, then schedule CSV distribution pulls

candidates.source_name: MF ČR — Otevřená data: publikační plán a výroční zpráva
candidates.why_relevant: The ministry's annual open-data report and publication plan announce which datasets will be opened next — a forward-looking pointer letting the intelligence programme anticipate new machine-readable financial-sector series rather than discover them late.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch of the výroční zpráva + publikační plán PDFs; diff dataset lists year over year
queries_used: data.gov.cz otevřená data Ministerstvo financí finanční trh

candidates.source_name: MF ČR — Zpráva o vývoji finančního trhu (annual financial market development report)
candidates.why_relevant: The ministry's flagship annual report quantifies household financial assets by product including cash holdings ('nebo držený v hotovosti'), bank deposits and market structure, and narrates national and EU legislative change affecting payments. Directly relevant to cash-usage and market-sizing workstreams; back-issues available from ~2014.
candidates.access_status: public, free PDF; also published in English in some years
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual (mid-year) fetch of the report PDF and its statistical annex tables; monitor the section index page for new year folders
queries_used: Ministerstvo financí ČR "Zpráva o vývoji finančního trhu" statistiky

candidates.source_name: MF ČR / financnigramotnost.gov.cz — Měření úrovně finanční gramotnosti
candidates.why_relevant: Quinquennial nationally representative survey (>1,000 respondents, 100+ questions; latest wave January 2025) run by MF with ČNB and fed into the OECD/INFE international comparison. Covers household budgeting, payment discipline, product holding and consumer behaviour — a rare official behavioural source outside the central bank.
candidates.access_status: public results pages + PDF releases; microdata not published
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the results index for new thematic instalments (results are released in parts across months); archive PDFs
queries_used: Ministerstvo financí měření finanční gramotnosti výzkum ČNB MF ČR platební chování

candidates.source_name: Finanční správa ČR — EET / EET 2.0 programme pages and technical documentation
candidates.why_relevant: The tax administration is re-launching electronic sales records (EET 2.0), publishing technical guidelines for POS/cash-register vendors, a test environment and DIS+ integration timelines. This is a first-order regulatory driver for POS terminal and cash-register demand in CZ and a source of aggregate transaction-reporting statistics.
candidates.source_subtype: tax authority programme / technical spec publisher
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor press-release feed and the EET technical-documentation section for spec releases and deadline changes
queries_used: Finanční správa ČR otevřená data EET elektronická evidence tržeb datové sady

candidates.source_name: Portál statistik MPO (Ministry of Industry and Trade statistics portal)
candidates.why_relevant: Launched June 2024, publishes time series of financial indicators for non-financial enterprises and trade-sector aggregates (employment, revenue, commercial margins in wholesale/retail). Provides the merchant-economics context for POS acceptance and interchange discussions. English mirror exists.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Inspect portal for export/API endpoints; otherwise scheduled table exports for trade (NACE 45-47) sections
queries_used: MPO ministerstvo průmyslu a obchodu otevřená data maloobchod e-commerce statistiky

candidates.why_relevant: Operational documentation of how state organisations use payment accounts and ČNB-issued payment cards. Indirect but reveals public-sector card issuance/acceptance arrangements and procurement-adjacent detail, and MONITOR exposes public-budget data as open data.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency page monitoring; harvest MONITOR open datasets via data.mf.gov.cz

candidates.why_relevant: Sector regulator open-data portal surfaced while searching NKOD-linked publishers. Relevant indirectly: mobile/broadband penetration and postal-services data condition mobile payment, e-commerce delivery and cash-on-delivery behaviour; also a template for how CZ regulators expose LKOD datasets.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Catalogue harvest, filtered to postal-services and electronic-communications usage datasets

negative_findings.description: No dedicated CZ open dataset on data.gov.cz combining payment cards, ATM counts or cash-usage shares was located. Searches in Czech using 'platební karty', 'bankomaty', 'hotovost' returned ČNB pages rather than NKOD dataset records.
negative_findings.result_summary: Card/ATM series appear to be produced by ČNB (a different coverage cell), not by the statistical office or ministries; the open-data layer for this cell carries context (retail, ICT, household budgets), not payment-instrument counts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-expecting card/ATM series from ČSÚ or MF; the A4 card/ATM backbone must be sourced from the central-bank cell, with this cell supplying denominators and behavioural context.

negative_findings.description: No standalone ČSÚ survey specifically measuring cash-versus-card payment shares at point of sale was found. The closest official instruments are the household ICT survey (internet banking / online purchasing) and Statistika rodinných účtů (expenditure structure, not tender type).
negative_findings.result_summary: Cash-usage share in CZ appears not to be measured by the statistical office; it is inferred from ČNB currency-in-circulation data or from private studies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Signals a structural gap: 'cash usage' as a topic cannot be fully served from national statistical infrastructure and will need central-bank plus commercial/industry sources.

negative_findings.description: The DataStat API endpoint pattern (https://data.csu.gov.cz/api/dotaz/v1/data/vybery/{code}) and the data.gov.cz SPARQL endpoint (https://data.gov.cz/sparql) were identified from official documentation but were not exercised in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Endpoints documented, not tested by this analyst; liveness and rate limits unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification must confirm these before a harvester is built; a failure would push collection back to brittle HTML/JSF scraping.

negative_findings.description: ČSÚ has migrated from czso.cz to csu.gov.cz, and MF ČR from mfcr.cz to mf.gov.cz. Both old and new hostnames still return content in search results, with some deep links (e.g. VDB at vdb.czso.cz) still on the legacy domain.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dual-domain estate; legacy URLs may redirect, mirror, or eventually 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any URL registry for this cell must store both hostnames and treat a single 404 on a legacy path as a migration hypothesis rather than a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: Point-of-sale tender mix (cash vs card vs mobile wallet) is not covered by any national statistical or ministry source identified in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign to central-bank and industry-association cells (ČNB payment statistics, SBK/bankovnikarty.cz, acquirer and retail-association studies); consider Eurostat/ECB SPACE study as a comparative fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: Digitální a informační agentura (DIA), the operator of data.gov.cz and gov.cz service catalogue, was not directly profiled; nor were subordinate MF bodies (Celní správa, Generální finanční ředitelství) as individual open-data publishers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass over NKOD publisher facets to enumerate every CZ public-sector publisher with finance/retail themed datasets, and profile DIA as the institutional owner of the open-data stack.

coverage_gaps.description: Microdata access routes were not investigated: ČSÚ anonymised microdata (SRÚ, SILC, ICT surveys) are available only under a formal request/contract procedure that was not documented in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Document the ČSÚ microdata request procedure, pricing and confidentiality conditions before any analysis that needs household-level payment or expenditure detail.

coverage_gaps.description: English coverage of this cell is thin: only 'Information Society in Figures' and the MPO portal English mirror were confirmed. Most ministry and open-data material is Czech-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for Czech-language extraction (cs NLP / translation in the pipeline) rather than relying on English mirrors, which lag and omit annexes.

coverage_gaps.description: Release calendars were not captured. ČSÚ 'Rychlé informace' publish on a fixed schedule and MF reports annually mid-year, but exact dates were not collected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the ČSÚ katalog produktů release calendar and MF publication plan to schedule collection instead of polling blindly.

brief: Czechia's non-central-bank statistical infrastructure is unusually well developed and largely machine-readable: ČSÚ (csu.gov.cz, migrated from czso.cz) publishes retail turnover, household budget (SRÚ/SILC) and Eurostat-harmonised ICT surveys covering internet banking and online purchasing, exposed through the VDB database, a DataStat JSON-STAT API and an LKOD open-data catalogue. Discovery is best driven top-down from the National Open Data Catalogue at data.gov.cz (DCAT-AP with SPARQL/TPF/GraphQL endpoints) and from MF ČR's own portal data.mf.gov.cz (1,100+ datasets, EET topic area), with the annual Zpráva o vývoji finančního trhu and the quinquennial financial-literacy survey supplying cash-holding and behavioural context. The critical live policy driver in this cell is EET 2.0 at Finanční správa, whose POS/cash-register technical guidelines and 2026 timeline directly shape terminal demand. The principal limitation is that payment-instrument counts (cards, ATMs) and point-of-sale tender mix are not produced here at all and must come from the central-bank and industry-association cells.
